name: Robe of the Overflowing Spirit, Void
body:
Price 12,500 gp; Aura moderate necromancy; CL 9th; Slot BODY; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This robe shines with a vibrant silvery sheen its cloth constantly moving and flowing, even when there is no air to jostle it.

The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on all Intimidate checks. Wearers with the spirit ability can access additional powers when they gain spirit in excess of their normal maximum capacity. When this happens, the robe consumes the extra spirit points, and the wearer may activate the ability as a free action, otherwise the points are wasted. After consuming spirit, the next attack that the wearer of this robe hits with deals an additional 1d6 negative energy damage for each point of Spirit consumed, and sickens the creature for 1 round if they are currently demoralized.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 7,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells vampiric touch
